headline: HuyenBao v13.0 — Mobile-first redesign: bottom nav + collapsible PinZone + touch-friendly
summary: MAJOR MOBILE REDESIGN. Bottom navigation bar (fixed at bottom, icon-only, 8 groups, thumb-friendly). Collapsible PinZone (compact by default on mobile — tap ▲ to expand charts). Top nav hidden on mobile (replaced by bottom bar). Touch-friendly minimums (44px tap targets, 12px font floor). Footer hidden on mobile. Desktop layout completely unchanged.
features: NEW: Fixed bottom navigation bar — 8 group icons (Character/Assets/Edu/Career/Finance/Biz/Network/Empire), accent-gold active state, safe-area-inset padding for notched phones
NEW: Sub-tab strip above bottom bar — horizontal scroll, icon-only, active = dark inverted pill
NEW: Collapsible PinZone — collapsed by default on mobile (identity + stats + toggle only), tap ▲ to expand charts + warnings + age track
NEW: Top gnav + subnav hidden on mobile (replaced by bottom nav)
NEW: Touch-friendly — 44px minimum tap targets, 48px bottom nav icons, 12px font floor
NEW: Content padding-bottom for bottom nav clearance
FIX: Desktop layout completely unchanged — all mobile rules in @media (max-width:700px)
